segmentation: Four beat groups with fixed three second fallback
node_features: 64 bin log mel mean and standard deviation
7 spectral contrast mean and standard deviation
spectral centroid bandwidth rolloff zero crossing rate and root mean square mean and standard deviation
normalization: StandardScaler fitted on training graph nodes only
graph_model: Two layer residual GraphSAGE with global mean pooling
cnn_model: Residual convolutional neural network on 128 bin log mel spectrograms
loss: Cross entropy loss with training label smoothing
